meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在 NanoClaw 群组里搭建持久化 wiki:创建 wiki/ 和 sources/ 目录、index.md 与 log.md,生成容器技能,并在群组 CLAUDE.md 中加入维护说明。之后 Claude 会按说明把资料逐条吸收进 wiki。
howto.when: 当你说出“add wiki”“wiki”“knowledge base”等触发词时,Claude 会为群组搭建 wiki 知识库。

say.text: 给这个群组加一个 wiki 知识库
say.note: Claude 会读取模式并和你讨论。

say.text: 新建一个专用群组来放 wiki
say.note: Claude 会问频道并注册群组。

say.text: 把这批文件收进 wiki,逐个处理
say.note: Claude 会一个一个读取并写入。

howto.what_en: Claude sets up a persistent wiki in a NanoClaw group — creates wiki/ and sources/, index.md/log.md, a container skill, and a CLAUDE.md section — then ingests files one at a time.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'add wiki', 'wiki', 'knowledge base', etc.

say_en.text: Add a wiki knowledge base to this group
say_en.note: Claude reads the pattern and discusses with you.

say_en.text: Create a dedicated group for the wiki
say_en.note: Claude asks for channel and chat, then registers.

say_en.text: Ingest these files into the wiki, one by one
